title: Formatting is limited
body: The formatting is great. However—as the title may suggest to you—it needs some improvement. I would like to suggest a number of things for your consideration: 1. The ability to resize table rows & columns, as well as the ability to align text and format it; 2. Very basic text alignment options, namely Right/Center/Left/Justify; 3. The ability for math expressions to work inside of tables; 4. An apple notes file format and an export option for it, to make transferring documents easier. Exporting as TXT makes the file lose all of its formatting, and exporting as PDF makes the file uneditable. It would be nice if there was a custom file type dedicated to Apple Notes.
author: Aleksandar5899
